definitions.explanation: The act of fully showing or utilizing one's abilities, skills, or power. Often used with する to form a verb.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{試合|しあい}で{実力|じつりょく}を{発揮|はっき}した。
examples.english: She demonstrated her true ability in the match.

examples.japanese: リーダーシップを{発揮|はっき}して、チームをまとめた。
examples.english: He demonstrated leadership and brought the team together.

examples.japanese: {緊張|きんちょう}して{本来|ほんらい}の{力|ちから}が{発揮|はっき}できなかった。
examples.english: I was nervous and couldn't demonstrate my true potential.

notes:
{発揮|はっき}する means to demonstrate, display, or bring out one's abilities or qualities. It implies actively showing what one is capable of.

Common collocations:
- {実力|じつりょく}を{発揮|はっき}する (to demonstrate one's ability)
- {能力|のうりょく}を{発揮|はっき}する (to display one's capabilities)
- リーダーシップを{発揮|はっき}する (to show leadership)
- {才能|さいのう}を{発揮|はっき}する (to exhibit one's talent)
- {効果|こうか}を{発揮|はっき}する (to produce an effect)

Used with できる to express whether one was able to perform at one's best:
- {力|ちから}を{発揮|はっき}できた (was able to show my abilities)
- {発揮|はっき}できなかった (couldn't perform at my best)
